guidance: Every target is visible from the start: bright yellow rungs, a hovering helicopter, a labelled distance deck
Gap names describe the action ('Into the Heli'); potato count rises with rung height
designLogic: One structure, many calibrated targets: height (rungs), distance (deck), precision (cabin)
A hovering vehicle as the showpiece target: air into an object
Failure cost is nil: a miss falls back into the pipe, so the level is a max-vert practice space
The remake places its pickups at the structure's extremes (top of the tower, top of the low deck)
remakeChanges: Unlock: 3 golds with every character (original) -> gold in every competition with one skater (remake)
Setting: halfpipe under a sunset sky (VG) -> on a container ship at sea with containers and a superstructure (LP12)
Gaps: 9 on VG -> 10 in PS12 (adds Rail Hop)
Pickups added: VV logo at the top of the tall vert section; alien plushie on the low deck
transfer: Height-ladder crystal stand: three trick-rail rungs above a pumpable halfpipe's coping; crystal just above the top rung so only a pumped vert air plus a grind ollie (≈ 2.4 m pop) reaches it
Air into a moving object: a moving platform (helicopter) hovering beside the halfpipe on a short loop with the crystal in its cabin
Distance deck: a detached landing deck with marked distances; crystal at the far mark (≈ 27 m) needing a speed pad or ramp lip plus a full charged ollie (≈ 13.8 m)
Use the structure's extremes: crystal at the tallest point, small pickup on the lowest deck
openQuestions: Launch point for the 70/80/90 ft gaps in the original and what the deck represents
Wall, tower and rung heights in metres (no usable side view)
Whether the helicopter moves during play
